Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — Checked service status and deployment history. The deployment history showed:
   - v2.2.9 — healthy in production
   - v2.3.0 — healthy in production (most recent healthy release)
   - v2.3.1 — unhealthy in production (current, bad)
   - v2.3.1-rc — unhealthy in staging

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** (the most recent release that was healthy in production) in all regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident** — Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer. The first attempt timed out, so I retried and it succeeded.

**Verification:** Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate down to 0.002.
